entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
aliases: Tetrarch of the Free Realm of Bryce
entities.description: Governor of Bryce on Dominaria, an aging man of keen mind who rallied allies to end Johan's War.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: A conflict between Bryce and Tirras orchestrated by Johan.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Orchestrated the war with Tirras; died ending the war.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Hazezon's ex-wife, leader of the Robaran Mercenaries.

entities.name: Jaeger Ojanen
entities.description: A strange tiger man of the forest of Efrava who aided Hazezon; died.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Son of Jaeger who allied with Hazezon and ended Johan's War by ensuring Johan's death.

events.summary: Hazezon rallies his ex-wife Adira Strongheart and the Robaran Mercenaries with the aid of Jaeger Ojanen.
events.quote: Hazezon rallied his ex-wife Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries with the aid of Jaeger Ojanen

events.summary: After Jaeger's death, Hazezon allies with Jedit Ojanen and ends Johan's War by ensuring Johan's death.
events.quote: Hazezon allied with Jaeger's son, Jedit Ojanen , eventually ending Johan's War by ensuring his death.
